_commentaire: Per-application escape hatches. Paths are relative to the manifest's
directory and CANNOT escape it: a `..` or an absolute path outside the
directory is rejected. A hook script read from JSON and executed as root is
an arbitrary-code-execution primitive, hence four safeguards:
4. not writable by group or others
Prepare a hook:  chown root:wheel hooks/pre-install.sh && chmod 755 hooks/pre-install.sh
